title: Spike: pane.graphics board rendering
description: Probe pane.graphics.set (socket method, CLI-unexposed): schema from herdr api schema, render a generated image (e.g. wave-progress chart PNG built with Go stdlib image) into a pane in the isolated session; document capabilities/limits (formats, sizing, persistence, interaction with TUI panes) in docs/design/experiments/pane-graphics.md + the generator script. Verdict: is a graphical board mode worth a real tick?
